FERPA 99.31(a)(1)(ii).Title: Reasonable methods to limit school officials' access

Checks.Title: No one can delete student records
Checks.Fix: Add a Deny like DenyStudentRecordsDelete, on s3:DeleteObject and s3:DeleteObjectVersion for student records, to every group and role that can write them.
Checks.Keep: DenyStudentRecordsDelete on every group and role that can write student records, and the ProtectStudentRecords SCP on the Schools OU.

Checks.Title: Only counselors can read counseling notes
Checks.Fix: Narrow TeacherReadGrades from district-student-records/* to the folders teachers need, and add a bucket policy Deny on counseling/* for everyone but counselors, using aws:PrincipalArn as OnlyITAdminChangesThePolicy does.
Checks.Keep: Reads of counseling/* only through the counselors' bucket policy grant.

Checks.Title: Only registrars can read roster exports
Checks.Fix: Replace "*" in ShareRosterWithVendor with the vendor's account or role ARN, or share the export with a presigned URL, and turn on S3 Block Public Access.
Checks.Keep: Roster exports shared with the vendor's account or role by name, never with "*".

Checks.Title: Changing student records needs MFA
Checks.Fix: Take ITAdminFullS3 off user alee, so IT staff change records through the ITAdmin role, which needs MFA to assume, and give ITAdminFullS3 a Deny like RequireMfaForChanges.
Checks.Keep: An MFA Deny like RequireMfaForChanges on every policy that can change student records.

Checks.Title: Assuming the IT admin role needs MFA
Checks.Fix: Add Bool aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent true to every statement in ITAdmin's trust policy that allows sts:AssumeRole.
Checks.Keep: The Bool aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent true condition in ITAdmin's trust policy.

Checks.Title: Registrars can update their own campus's records
Checks.Fix: Registrars change records with MFA, by design. If they can't even with MFA, check RegistrarCampusRecords and each registrar's campus tag.
Checks.Keep: RegistrarCampusRecords on the Registrars group, and each registrar's campus tag.

Checks.Title: Only teachers can read lesson plans
Checks.Fix: Describe district-lesson-plans in the account file's Resources, with its bucket policy or as {} if it has none, so the analyzer can answer.
Checks.Keep: Lesson plan reads only through the Teachers group's policies.
